title: Exclude arbitrary-slot single-role BIT idle fusion (0% κ change)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN. Exact conditional κ change 0%.** On the exact retained #7001 E-free caller, deleting any two IDLE_ONE events with disjoint stage masks changes the full scalar operator by rank at least two at a valid field specialization. Inserting one one-role idle changes the operator by rank at most one at any clock. Thus this fixed-remaining-word, single-role fusion scope has exact whole-word savings upper zero against the 60.10389921914735 raw-unit BIT shortfall at κ = 0.0040075385047236.

The 32 old idle events give 496 unordered pairs. The disjoint-mask scope has 256 pairs, all certified with zero unresolved. The former free rank-additive packing upper is about 305.936709245460 raw units. Multiple changed operations, overlapping masks and genuine multi-role replacements are outside the scope.

## Task and overlap

Changed BIT caller paid-idle scope on canonical e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. #7201 studies two-field same-mask volume, #7188 reprices lane-wise regrouping, and #7144/#7166 concern complex caller or rectangular transport scopes. The exact comparison remains #7277 at ed090b57ed88f8859e5ff4643645099e6ba856ea, κ = 0.003645669928698.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12 and assertions enabled:

~~~sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/bit-single-role-idle-rank-bound
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/bit-single-role-idle-rank-bound --check-modes --check-source-history
~~~

The primary GF(256) whole-matrix replay and independent GF(128) minor witnesses cover all 256 pairs. The independent verifier rebuilds all 62,474 lineage edges and the complete 36-copy signed bill, rejecting omitted paid idle and native MOVE controls. Registered replay, committed-source and mode checks, navigation and Git-free export passed. Three canonical source paths are pinned. The branch inherits the exact two #7257 replay prerequisites.

## Credit and open next questions

#6726/#7001/#6980 supply the native and caller sources, #7294 the retained BIT pricing lineage, #7201/#7188 the closest BIT packing comparisons, and #7277 the complete benchmark. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted.

An exact multi-role primitive or additional paid changes need a fresh full-stock bound and signed arbitrary-input, ownership and restoration proof before a build.
